method: Original SVG geometry, rendered to PNG with Chromium. No generative-image model used.

concepts.name: The Workbench
concepts.description: A block above a sturdy bench. The open centre gives the mark a welcoming, workshop-like silhouette.

concepts.name: The Joint
concepts.description: Two stepped pieces fit around a shared opening. A small nod to joinery, assembly and a companion working with you.
concepts.note: The closest to your abstract references.

concepts.name: The Helping Hand
concepts.description: A pixel palm supports one square piece. It turns “Your Ideas, A Helping Hand” into a compact symbol.
concepts.note: The strongest expression of the promise.

concepts.name: The Built B
concepts.description: A stepped B with two open bays and an offset building block. Echoes the pixel B already in the wordmark.

concepts.name: The Maker M
concepts.description: Two upright supports and a stepped centre create an M. A small bridge between making, structure and BenchMate.
